sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that the petitioner Awadh Bihari Dubey in A.B.A. No.589 of 2024 is the father of Ashwini Kumar Dubey and petitioner Ashwini Kumar Dubey in A.B.A. No.499 of 2024 is the son of Awadh Bihari Dubey.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he has taken the instruction from the petitioners and they are ready to comply the terms and conditions made in the settlement pursuant to the direction of learned Sessions Judge passed in A.B.P. No.626 of 2023 which was taken place.

He submits that on the day of furnishing the bail bond, he will pay a sum of Rs.1 lakh in terms of the settlement and thereafter in nine installments he will pay to the tune of Rs.1 lakh every month by 15th day of every month.

5. Learned counsel appearing for the State submits that in spite of settlement arrived, the petitioner has not complied, in view of the learned Sessions Judge has been pleased to reject the anticipatory bail.
6. Learned counsel for the opposite party No.2 submits that if the petitioner is ready to comply the settlement between the parties, he has got no objection.
He submits that only the undertaking given before this Court is required to be complied by the petitioners.

7. In view of the above and considering the settlement and as --2-- A.B.A. No. 499 of 2024 with A.B.A. No. 589 of 2024 submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, the petitioner shall pay a sum of Rs.1 lakh on the day of surrender before the learned Court to the opposite party No.2 and they will go on paying rest of the amount by 15th day of every month to the tune of Rs.1 lakh every month till the completion of the remaining Rs.9 lacs,
I am inclined to provide privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

8. Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, is hereby directed to surrender before the learned Court within three weeks from today, and in the event of his surrender/arrest, the petitioner, above named, shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand), with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Garhwa, in connection with Complaint Case No. 1777 of 2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

9. If the undertaking given before this Court by the petitioner which is in view of the settlement reached between the parties not complied with the opposite party No.2 is put at liberty to move in accordance with law.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Sangam/
